rows.basis: The MD&A ties a $67.8M Datacom decrease to customer inventory digestion and slowing cloud data center capex, which is a cloud link stated in words with no AI amount. Seller-side signal: Cloud & Networking segment revenue was $1,322.5M, but the thesis does not name it as an AI or data-center line because it includes telecom.

The Q3 release says data center revenues reached a record quarter but gives no amount or share. Seller-side signal: Cloud & Networking revenue was $1,084.9M, which includes telecom and is not an AI line.

The release cites robust demand for cloud products supporting AI data centers. The MD&A says unit sales to cloud and AI/ML customers rose by $193.2M, partly from Cloud Light, which is an increment and not AI revenue. Seller-side signal: Cloud & Networking revenue was $1,410.8M, which includes telecom.

The MD&A cites increasing demand from AI and cloud customers expanding data centers, and revenue rose 83% to $3,014.0M. Lumentum has had one reportable segment since FY2026, and Components and Systems are product lines rather than markets, so no AI share or amount is stated.

Management expected cloud applications to drive over 30% of Cloud & Networking revenue in calendar 2024, with growth driven by AI compute. That share is of one segment, not of total revenue, and covers cloud rather than AI specifically, so it is not applied to the total.

Management expected the Cloud Light acquisition to more than double cloud data center infrastructure revenue and expected accelerated growth in calendar 2025 from cloud and AI customers. No amount was given.
Management expected continued strong AI data center and long-haul demand and to surpass $600M in quarterly revenue by June 2026. That $600M is a total-revenue target, not AI revenue.
The release says AI demand drives a Q1 FY2027 revenue guidance midpoint of $1.25B. That figure is total quarterly revenue, not an AI amount.
The company said it is expanding leading-edge transceiver manufacturing capacity given the bandwidth demands of AI data centers. No amount or share of capex was stated.

none_found.reason: no statement links FY2022 revenue to AI or cloud data centers; the Cloud & Networking and OpComms segments include telecom and are not AI lines
no expansion stated as being for AI demand with an amount
no expansion stated as being for AI demand with an amount
capacity expansion is stated only in general terms (scope total) with no AI amount
capex of $231.0M includes an AI transceiver capacity expansion stated in words only, with no amount split
capex of $451.3M (and construction in progress rising to $377.4M) has no stated AI amount or share; PP&E category method is not allowed for this industry
purchase commitments ($2,354.4M at FY2026) are not identified as AI and the thesis does not treat a component supplier's commitments as AI capex
no segment cost line and no statement attributes opex to AI in any year FY2022–FY2026
